definitions.commandAPM: Every submitted simulation command, including rejected attempts. A command can contain several unit orders. This is not physical input APM.
definitions.physicalInputAPM: Logged motor inputs with countsAPM other than false. Null when the commander does not emit physical input records.
definitions.firstOrder: First submitted command other than buy, stance or recover.
definitions.reactionSeconds: Event-associated physical inputs only. Legacy contact-to-target command delay is a separate proxy and cannot measure human reaction.
definitions.crossMap: Pairs of spatial commands no more than one second apart with target positions farther apart than screenSpan; commands without positions use addressed unit locations. Also reports quarter-second pairs and one command addressing multiple regions.
definitions.screenSpan: 160 metres by default, rounded from the 159.908-metre maximum width of the default 1920x1080 client camera footprint on flat ground (42-degree FOV, distance85, pitch0.95). This is a conservative spatial proxy, not a full camera-locality proof.
definitions.dwell: First-to-last input time for a logged attention cycle, not full focus residence including silence.
definitions.idle: Idle episodes sampled each second. This detects inactivity, not whether an idle unit was noticed.
definitions.opening: First five purchases and first three move target regions in the first 45 seconds, grouped by faction.
definitions.windows: Full non-overlapping 60-second windows and 10-second windows sliding every second, including quiet windows.

world.commandAPM: Every submitted simulation command, including rejected attempts. A command can contain several unit orders. This is not physical input APM.
world.physicalInputAPM: Logged motor inputs with countsAPM other than false. Null when the commander does not emit physical input records.
world.firstOrder: First submitted command other than buy, stance or recover.
world.reactionSeconds: First physical input per causal event ID and event tick. Separate distributions report first attempted and accepted commands per event. Legacy contact-to-target command delay is a separate proxy.
world.crossMap: Pairs of spatial commands no more than one second apart with target positions farther apart than screenSpan; commands without positions use addressed unit locations. Also reports quarter-second pairs and one command addressing multiple regions.
world.screenSpan: 160 metres by default, rounded from the 159.908-metre maximum width of the default 1920x1080 client camera footprint on flat ground (42-degree FOV, distance85, pitch0.95). This is a conservative spatial proxy, not a full camera-locality proof.
world.dwell: Measured attention residence from diagnostics, including silence. cycleInputSpanSeconds separately measures first-to-last input time for logged cycle IDs.
world.idle: Idle episodes sampled each second. Unnoticed idle is the delay until an idle unit next appears in diagnostic screenIds or receives a command. Units idle on capture points may be holding intentionally; screen visibility is a notice proxy, not proof of awareness.
world.opening: First five purchases and first three move target regions in the first 45 seconds, grouped by faction.
world.windows: Full non-overlapping 60-second windows and 10-second windows sliding every simulation tick, including quiet windows.
